title: Phase 2 on the team site: every page that shows records reads them when it opens (board done; runs, schedule, vaults, members next), so an agent's release is live without a round
note: Dev, 27 October 00:10 London: the team site's record pages are live, no round needed: the board; the schedule and each agent's page (cards, runs, messages); the vault register; each member's status and rounds (admin/agents/<id>/, screenshots served by team, no longer broken links to v1); each team member's tasks (team/<id>/); the status page; the runs page's scheduled wakes. Each compared with the build from the same records: identical. Still built (a round to change): the briefs page, the Sherpa's pages, the advisories, the roles page, the commit notes. Then site and data. | The editor's go, 26 October. Live, no round needed: the board (/admin/board/), the schedule pages (/team/schedule/ and each agent's: cards, runs, messages) and the vault register (/team/vaults/), from records/index/*.json written by team's own deploy. Next: the member pages, /team/status/, /team/runs/; then site and data. | The editor's go, 26 October. The board was first: records/index/board.json is written by team's own deploy, and /admin/board/ reads it. This row was released to team alone, with no round, to prove it.
